measurement_invalidation.cause: The v1 aggregator treated CUDA user-annotation range mirrors as real work and used recursive FunctionEvent.device_time_total, which also includes GPU annotation spans attached as CPU kernels. Annotation duration can include launch gaps.
measurement_invalidation.correction: v2 excludes raw Kineto CUDA annotation events and attributes only actual kernel/copy durations through linked CPU correlation and disjoint CPU stage ownership. Host stages count CPU annotations only.
invalidated_claims: Profiler-derived CUDA device durations and named device stage costs
Named stage call counts, which counted CPU and mirrored CUDA annotations
retained_claims: Original receipts and imported file hashes remain preserved and verifiable
Uninstrumented latency samples are measured separately without profiler hooks and are unaffected by this classification bug
Independent original-QP CUDA certificates are computed after each solve outside timing and are unaffected by this classification bug
measurement_invalidation.retained_claims_limit: Retaining unaffected raw observations does not qualify old device-work attribution or substitute for the corrected paired rerun and all-sample parity reconciliation.
